name: Cinder retinue
tactics: The bowman marks vulnerable prey while the bruiser attacks, the whisper raises stress, and the channeler prepares a party-wide blast. Interrupt the preparation or guard its release, then exploit the channeler’s recovery action. Focus the fragile whisper or bowman to reduce pressure. Each enemy has fixed strength.
